coverage.evidence: RandomTemplateHelpers.cs:37-43 lists random.number, random.decimal, random.percent, random.bool, random.letter and random.color, and :74-80 maps one input to 1..max and two or three inputs to min|max|step. RandomNumberSpec.cs:22-41 takes 2 or 3 whole parts, needs step >= 1 and max >= min, and returns false otherwise. RandomTemplateHelpers.cs:85-93 makes decimal take exactly min|max|places with places at most 8 (:27). PickTemplateHelpers.cs:33-37 and :115-161 give pick, pick.inline (split at ';'), pick.weighted (weight=item, weight >= 0) and pick.n (count >= 1, then items). ChanceTemplateHelpers.cs:37-42 takes 2 or 3 inputs with a percent from 0 to 100. LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:836-903 handles the dotted random.number and the roll.<name>.<min>.<max>[.<step>], roll.<name> and roll.<name>.complement forms. LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:507-519 splits random.pick.a.b.c at the dots.

RandomNumberSpec.cs:46-50 draws min + k*step, so the min always can occur and the max only on the step, which gives {random.number:1|10|4} as 1, 5 or 9. RandomTemplateHelpers.cs:55-64 gives percent 0..100 with '%', true/false, A..Z and '#'+X6 hex, and returns null (printed as typed) when a no-input helper gets an argument (:70-71). The decimal uses F<places> formatting (:95-96). PickTemplateHelpers.cs:163 joins pick.n and pick.shuffle with ', ', and :160 with Take(count) returns all items when n is larger. ChanceTemplateHelpers.cs:44-45 with LogicArguments.cs:63-67 gives empty when there is no else branch. LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:901 gives complement as 100 minus the value, and :892-893 leaves a roll read with no draw unresolved. QuoteText.cs:21-34 formats #N "text" (name, date).

TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:32-40 puts Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord and Webhook in AllContexts, and :616-647 registers random.user, the dotted random.number forms, the roll forms and random.pick there without Viewer. LogicHelperProvider.cs:45-55 opens the logic rows (pick, chance, random.number and the other random.* rows) to StandardAndViewer. ComposingRows.cs:33 keeps chatter and quote rows Standard only. TemplateResolver.cs:124-128 and :155-156 return null in viewer text for any key outside the Viewer set. features.mdx:51 names Viewer Templates.

PickTemplateHelpers.cs:64-69 uses NoImmediateRepeatPicker keyed by broadcaster and node.Raw outside viewer text, and a plain random draw in viewer text. LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:513-517 does the same for random.pick keyed by broadcaster and key. NoImmediateRepeatPicker.cs:29 and :46-53 keep an in-memory last index per key, so the memory is lost on restart and works by position, which lets duplicate text repeat. LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:832-834 and :841-857 resolve dotted number keys once per render because the needed set is a HashSet. RandomTemplateHelpers.cs:53 draws for each colon node. LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:876-888 lets the first roll definition win.

ChatMessageHandler.cs:172-175 adds every chatter to SessionChatters whether live or offline. ChannelOnlineHandler.cs:153 clears it at stream-online, and no other Clear exists in server/src (grep). IChannelRegistry.cs:304 shows it is an in-memory ConcurrentDictionary, so it empties on restart. ChatterTemplateHelpers.cs:56-60 renders empty for an empty pool and adds '@' for mention, and :75-91 makes notMe exclude the trigger user. LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:496-506 makes random.user fall back to the user variable or 'someone'. QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:69-72 and :107-108 return null, printed as typed, when there is no quote.

reader_answers.evidence: PickTemplateHelpers.cs:47 takes pick items as pipe arguments. RandomTemplateHelpers.cs:74-80 with RandomNumberSpec.cs:22-41 supports one input (1..max), two inputs (min..max) and an optional third input (step).

TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:32-40 matches the listed surfaces. TemplateResolver.cs:124-128 limits viewer text to Viewer-context helpers. LogicHelperProvider.cs:55 versus ComposingRows.cs:33 shows that some helpers are excluded from viewer text.

RandomNumberSpec.cs:25-37 rejects malformed or inverted ranges, and RandomTemplateHelpers.cs:70-71 returns null when a no-input helper gets an argument. A null render leaves the token as typed (TemplateResolver.cs:155-163). LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:832-834 shows dotted keys reused once per render, while RandomTemplateHelpers.cs:53 draws for each colon node.
PickTemplateHelpers.cs:64-69 shows pick avoids an immediate repeat for broadcaster templates. RandomTemplateHelpers.cs:76-78 shows two inputs give min..max, so {random.number:10|50} draws 10 to 50.
